title.zh: 将北苏里高省 Surigao 市 Taft 描笼涯的 Surigao 市国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Taft 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Surigao City National High School – Taft Annex in Barangay Taft, City of Surigao, Province of Surigao Del Norte From the Surigao City National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Taft National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Taft của Trường Trung học Thành phố Surigao Quốc gia tại Barangay Taft, Thành phố Surigao, Tỉnh Surigao Del Norte khỏi Trường Trung học Thành phố Surigao Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Taft Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Taft ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเมือง Surigao แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Taft เมือง Surigao จังหวัด Surigao Del Norte ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเมือง Surigao แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Taft แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Taft, Sekolah Menengah Kota Surigao Nasional di Barangay Taft, Kota Surigao, Provinsi Surigao Del Norte dari Sekolah Menengah Kota Surigao Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Taft Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Taft, Sekolah Menengah Bandar Surigao Kebangsaan di Barangay Taft, Bandar Surigao, Wilayah Surigao Del Norte daripada Sekolah Menengah Bandar Surigao Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Taft Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. – The Surigao City National High School – Taft Annex in Barangay Taft, City of Surigao, Province of Surigao del Norte is hereby separated from the Surigao City National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Taft National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Surigao City National High School – Taft Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Taft National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Taft National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the Surigao City National High School – Taft Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
